notes.rate: Configurable flat tariff in LKR per kWh (e.g. 32.50 LKR/kWh)
notes.baseline_watts: Baseline idle system power floor in Watts; never reported as measured
notes.psu_efficiency: AC-to-DC conversion efficiency percentage of the power supply unit (50 to 98)
notes.slab: Set true to enable Sri Lankan CEB/LECO tiered progressive domestic slabs for monthly estimates
notes.wall_meter: Optional HTTP URL or local JSON file path for external smart plug (e.g. Shelly or Tasmota)
notes.custom_tdp: Optional CPU Thermal Design Power override in Watts (e.g. 65.0)
